requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5256-5567-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5256-5567-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1013-3459-7839.description:
Activate Battered Golem using the ability granted to it by Hypervolt Grasp by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-2897.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-2897.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Hulking Metamorph and Gigantoplasm each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-2897.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

11-109.manaNeeded: {U}{U}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
11-109.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand with valid targets as applicable.
11-109.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, copying Fork targeting the spell cast in step 1 and returning the original Fork to your hand.
Cast Fork by paying its mana cost, copying the copy of Fork, targeting the copy of Fork.
Resolve the copy of Fork, creating a copy of Fork targeting the copy of Fork.
Repeat step 5.

513-4067-6896.easyPrerequisites:
You have a nonland permanent card in hand that costs {2} or less.
You control a nontoken nonland permanent that costs {2} or less.
513-4067-6896.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a nonland permanent card that costs {2} or less.
Cast the permanent from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {0} due to Green Goblin.
Hullbreaker Horror trigger, returning another nonland permaennt that costs 2 or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 2.
Repeat.

2034-4907-6989-7444.easyPrerequisites: Advanced Reconstruction is at least level 3.
2034-4907-6989-7444.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {1} due to Advanced Reconstruction. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Advanced Reconstruction triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tatterkite, adding {C}{C}
Repeat.

1617-4831-4983-5358-7063.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1617-4831-4983-5358-7063.description:
Cast Ember Island Production by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
1617-4831-4983-5358-7063.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a stun counter on it

514-654-2511-5944.description:
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Amulet of Vigor.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters, Amulet of Vigor and The Mycosynth Gardens trigger, untapping Unstoppable Slasher twice, which will instead remove both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2493-4276-6991.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2493-4276-6991.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Donnie & April.
When Archaeomancer and Donnie & April enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2493-4276-6991.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2919-4186-4476.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-4186-4476.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

955-3259-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
955-3259-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

2741-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
2741-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

413-1429-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-1429-5958.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Staiton.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

586-4790-5334.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {B}.
Repeat.

1479-4862-5478-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4862-5478-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Omnath trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4929-4934-5220.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary and Amareth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Cryptic Trilobite on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to reveal Cryptic Trilobite from the top of your library and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

1636-3217.description:
Intruder Alarm's first ability prevents creatures from untapping during their controller's untap step.
Because Tocatli Honor Guard prevents abilities from triggering whenever a creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm's second ability does not trigger to untap them.

112-565-2743.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of Biovisionary.
Resolve Clockspinning, changing nothing and returning it to your hand.
Repeat two additional times, foregoing paying the buyback cost on the final iteration.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

2816-4659-5184-5309.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Black Market Tycoon.
Black Market Tycoon does not have summoning sickness.
2816-4659-5184-5309.description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing both Treasure tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Black Market Tycoon by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

859-1424-1496.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Lurking Roper.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
859-1424-1496.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
The Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Verdant Sun's Avatar, causing you to gain life equal to the Elf Warrior's toughness.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

1069-3661-5222-5256.description:
Cast Shield Sphere.
Equip Sword of the Realms to Shield Sphere for {0}.
Sacrifice Shield Sphere to Altar of Dementia to mill target player two.
Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Shield Sphere to your hand.
Repeat.

801-876-4763-5147.description:
Equip Impulsive Pilferer with Lightning Greaves.
Sacrifice Impulsive Pilferer to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Impulsive Pilferer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Koll triggers, returning Impulsive Pilferer to your hand.
Sacrifice the Treasure token for {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer.
Repeat.

801-4763-4955-5147.description:
Equip Impulsive Pilferer with Grafted Wargear.
Sacrifice Impulsive Pilferer to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Impulsive Pilferer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Koll triggers, returning Impulsive Pilferer to you hand.
Sacrifice the Treasure token for {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer.
Repeat.
